topic: R24 TABLESTYLE content-format value type and unit domains

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.tableStyleFields: §20.4.101.3: BL group 92 Value data type; BL group 93 Value unit type

implementation.change: R24 TABLESTYLE profile validation accepts the ODA §20.4.99 data types and R2007+ unit types rather than only 512 and 0. Unit validation is R24-specific and excludes values accepted by the older general TableStyle validator but not documented for this field. The writer emits both values in groups 92 and 93.

coverage: Every ODA data-type code is emitted and freshly typed-read in ASCII and Binary with unit type 0.
Each nonzero ODA unit type is emitted and freshly typed-read in ASCII and Binary with data type 512.
Undocumented data type 3 and unit type 0x10 are refused with destination preservation.
Existing TABLESTYLE rollback, unresolved/wrong-kind border-LTYPE refusal, same-adapter retry, and readback checks remain in the same selector.
control.fixture_policy: No drawing fixture is committed; all output is temporary and removed.

limits: This verifies bounded generated writer/readback transport for documented numeric codes only.
It does not establish every type/unit pairing's application meaning, native table rendering, physical DWG producer coverage, or whole-source conversion.
It does not change unsupported-profile refusal for other R24 TABLESTYLE fields.
